#compdef eos
# Zsh completion for repository-local EOS.
_eos() {
  local cmd="${words[1]}"
  local -a candidates argv_words
  argv_words=("${words[@]:1}")
  candidates=("${(@f)$("$cmd" completion candidates -- "${argv_words[@]}" 2>/dev/null)}")
  compadd -Q -- "${candidates[@]}"
}
compdef _eos eos
